info.title: Polymarket PolyBolt WebSocket
info.description: Real-time push socket for Polymarket market prices and licensed reference prices. One connection carries many channel subscriptions. Every server frame is a uniform envelope with a dense per-channel sequence, a snapshot barrier on subscribe, and typed close codes. Replaces the legacy Real-Time Data Service (RTDS).

production.description: Production socket. The same host serves the Polymarket web app's ticket endpoint; third-party clients authenticate gated channels with CLOB API credentials over the socket itself.

ws.title: Live Data Channel
ws.description: Send JSON text frames tagged with op. The server answers every op with an ack or an error ack (never a close, except for policy breaches, close 4008) and pushes envelopes for subscribed channels. Limits per connection: 64 active (channel, filter) subscriptions, 20 subscribe or unsubscribe frames per second (a batch frame counts once), 64 KB per frame, 8 auth attempts. The server sends a WebSocket ping every 25 seconds; two missed pongs close 4002. Close codes: 4001 authentication failed on a presented credential, 4002 slow consumer or pong timeout, 4003 server draining (reconnect once after a uniform 0 to 10 s delay), 4008 policy violation (fix the client; do not reconnect blindly).

subscribe.title: Subscribe
subscribe.summary: Add one or more (channel, filter) subscriptions
subscribe.description: Batch form: subscriptions is an array of {channel, filter}. Singular form: {op: subscribe, channel, filter}. Each newly added subscription is acknowledged with subscribed, then receives exactly one snapshot envelope (snapshot: true), then live frames. A duplicate (channel, filter) is acknowledged again without a new snapshot. A gated channel on an unauthenticated connection answers the non-closing error code auth_required; other subscriptions on the same connection are unaffected.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.summary: Remove subscriptions; same singular and batch shapes as subscribe

auth.title: Authenticate
auth.summary: Unlock the gated channels on this connection with CLOB API credentials or a web-app ticket
auth.description: Send before subscribing to price.crypto, price.equity, price.crypto.twap or price.equity.twap. Answered with authed. A refused credential answers the non-closing error code auth_invalid; an unreachable verifier answers auth_unavailable (retry later). Idempotent once authenticated. Lifetime budget of 8 auth frames per connection; the ninth closes 4008. The Polymarket web app uses a different credential in the same op (a one-time ticket in the ticket field); third-party clients use the auth object. A web-app ticket is minted from a Turnstile solve; when the widget carried this connection's challenge nonce (see the challenge frame) the ticket verifies on this socket alone, and one minted for another socket answers the non-closing auth_expired (mint again).

ping.title: Ping
ping.summary: Optional application-level liveness probe; answered with pong
ping.description: Not required for keepalive: the server sends WebSocket ping frames every 25 seconds and standard clients answer them automatically.

acknowledgements.title: Acknowledgements
acknowledgements.summary: challenge (on request), subscribed, unsubscribed, authed, pong and error acks; rid is echoed when the request carried one

pricePolymarket.title: price.polymarket
pricePolymarket.summary: Best bid and ask per outcome token (public, no auth)
pricePolymarket.description: Filter: {asset_id: <outcome token id, decimal string>}. Snapshot payload: the latest best bid and ask for the token, or an empty array [] when the token has not traded within the server's warm window. Live payload: one best-bid-and-ask object per change. Same-token updates are conflated (latest wins) when the client is slow.

priceCrypto.title: price.crypto
priceCrypto.summary: Pyth crypto reference prices, about one update per second per symbol (gated)
priceCrypto.description: Filter: {symbol}, lowercase, one of btcusd, ethusd, solusd, dogeusd, xrpusd, bnbusd. Snapshot payload: {symbol, data: [points for the previous two minutes]}. Live payload: one point.

priceEquity.title: price.equity
priceEquity.summary: Pyth equity, ETF, forex, metals and commodity reference prices (gated)
priceEquity.description: Filter: {symbol}, lowercase. Catalog: stocks aapl, tsla, msft, googl, amzn, meta, nvda, nflx, pltr, open, rklb, abnb, coin, hood; ETFs qqq, spy, ewy, vxx; forex eurusd, gbpusd, usdcad, usdjpy, usdkrw; precious metals xauusd, xagusd; commodities wti, cc, ngd (front-month futures, the symbol stays the root while the contract rolls). Snapshot payload: {symbol, source, data: [points for the previous two minutes]}. Live payload: one point with optional received_at and is_carried_forward. Every payload names the vendor that produced it in source (pyth, massive or chainlink; ownership is a per-symbol operator decision); during a rolling ownership flip old and new pods serve different vendors for the flipped symbol, so consecutive frames can carry different sources until the roll completes.

priceCryptoTwap.title: price.crypto.twap
priceCryptoTwap.summary: Chainlink time-weighted average prices used by crypto up/down market resolution (gated)
priceCryptoTwap.description: Filter: {symbol, window_seconds}. Only window_seconds 60 exists; symbols btcusd, ethusd, solusd, xrpusd, dogeusd, hypeusd, bnbusd. Another positive window is accepted but never carries data. Snapshot payload: {symbol, window_seconds, data: [points]}. Live payload: one point including window_seconds.

priceEquityTwap.title: price.equity.twap
priceEquityTwap.summary: Chainlink Data Streams FX time-weighted average prices (gated)
priceEquityTwap.description: Filter: {symbol, window_seconds}. Launch feeds eurusd and usdjpy at window_seconds 60; another positive window is accepted but never carries data. Ticket-gated like the other vendor channels and snapshot-then-live like price.crypto.twap. Snapshot payload: {symbol, window_seconds, source, data: [points]}. Live payload: one point including window_seconds and source. Every payload names the vendor that produced it in source; the channel is Chainlink-only today, so the value is chainlink.

challenge.title: Request the challenge
challenge.summary: Ask for this connection's challenge nonce
challenge.description: Ask for this connection's challenge nonce. The server never pushes it unasked: a client that authenticates with a ticket sends this right after the socket opens, then renders the Turnstile widget with the nonce as cData. Idempotent (the same nonce for the life of the connection, rid echoed) and metered like subscribe and auth. A nonce field in the request is ignored: a client can never choose its own. A server that predates this op answers the non-closing bad_op error ack with no rid (the frame did not parse): treat an uncorrelated bad_op while the request is pending as no nonce served, and render the widget without cData.

asset_id.description: Outcome token id (clobTokenIds entry), decimal string. Leading zeros are normalized.

provider.description: Optional provider pin (spec 08b). While the server's provider selector is DISABLED (PRICE_PROVIDER_SELECTOR_ENABLED=false, the default), this field is accepted and IGNORED like any unknown key: the lane's owner is served and the subscribed ack carries no provider. While it is ENABLED, the value must be one of the enum tokens; anything else (including massive, owner, numbers, null) is a bad_filter error ack. A pin the catalog serves gets that provider's stream; a pin it cannot serve falls back to the owner's stream, and the subscribed ack names the provider actually served. Ignored on price.polymarket.

window_seconds.description: Only 60 carries data today, on price.crypto.twap and price.equity.twap alike.

provider.description: Optional provider pin (spec 08b). While the server's provider selector is DISABLED (PRICE_PROVIDER_SELECTOR_ENABLED=false, the default), this field is accepted and IGNORED like any unknown key: the lane's owner is served and the subscribed ack carries no provider. While it is ENABLED, the value must be one of the enum tokens; anything else (including massive, owner, numbers, null) is a bad_filter error ack. A pin the catalog serves gets that provider's stream; a pin it cannot serve falls back to the owner's stream, and the subscribed ack names the provider actually served. Ignored on price.polymarket.

rid.description: Client request id, echoed on every ack this frame produces.

ticket.description: The one-time ticket from POST /api/ws-ticket (the Polymarket web app's credential), consumed by the attempt whatever the outcome. Minted from a Cloudflare Turnstile solve; when the widget was rendered with this connection's challenge nonce as cData, the ticket verifies only on this socket, whatever IP either request came from. A stale, consumed or unknown ticket, or one minted for another socket, answers the non-closing auth_expired: mint again.

AuthRequest.description: Exactly one credential per frame: auth (CLOB API credentials, third-party clients) or ticket (the web app). Zero or two answer the non-closing bad_op.

ClobCredentials.description: The CLOB L2 API credential trio, the same credentials used for the CLOB user WebSocket.

provider.description: subscribed acks only, vendor channels only, and only while the provider selector is enabled (spec 08b): the provider actually SERVED - the requested pin when the catalog serves it, else the lane's owner (massive is reachable on the omitted path only). Also present on the idempotent duplicate-subscribe ack. Absent everywhere else, including every ack while the selector is disabled.

code.description: bad_op malformed frame; bad_channel unknown channel; bad_filter missing or invalid filter; sub_limit 65th subscription (followed by close 4008); rate_limited more than 20 subscribe/unsubscribe frames per second (followed by close 4008); auth_required gated channel before auth; auth_expired consumed or unknown ticket (web app lane); auth_unavailable verifier unreachable, retry later; auth_invalid credentials refused; auth_attempts ninth auth frame (followed by close 4008).
